body:
Objective: Align Person JSON-LD identifier with `ktappdev`.
Context: Scout found `src/lib/structured-data.ts` is the only SEO identity mismatch: `identifier: "kentaylor"` appears at lines ~115 and ~187, while site source already uses `alternateName: "ktappdev"`, @ktappdev handles, GitHub/X sameAs, and sitemap/robots are configured. This helps Google associate query `ktappdev` with kentaylor.dev, but external Search Console registration remains separate.
Constraints: Minimal diff only. Do not add new schema types, dependencies, or speculative SEO changes.
Action steps:
1. Read project instructions and `src/lib/structured-data.ts`.
2. Change both Person JSON-LD `identifier: "kentaylor"` values to `identifier: "ktappdev"`.
3. Run the smallest relevant validation (typecheck/build if practical) and inspect diff.
Deliverables: changed file(s), validation result, concise note of any issue. Reply via picode_send.
